comments.text: Roswell was a cover up, so the Soviet Union wouldn't know we could detect their above ground nuclear tests via sound carried in the stratosphere. [LINK] I strongly agree that if the Nazis, Soviets, or any other opponent had technology of the sort that allowed antigravity, history couldn't have unfolded the way it did. I have zero faith that space aliens have anything to do with the fuzzy triangles or tic-tac videos. Those have far simpler explanations. See this video by "Thunderf00t" which gives really good earthy reasons for what's been seen. [VIDEO]
